what: Of several photos stacked in one spot, the top one is wiped from its right edge to the left over 1s with cubic-bezier(.45,1,.6,1), revealing the one below, it returns to the bottom after 1.1s, rests 3.5s, then the next one goes — starting 3.6s after all images load. With --fx-delay staggered at 0 · .3 · .6s across the three flower · mountain · leaf mask cells, each cell wipes at a different time (including the original’s quirk of moving on half-wiped when the delay is longer than swap)

options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Sections to stack (direct children) — two or more, the last child sits on top
options.first: Time from receiving the full image to the first wipe (sec), default 3.6
options.swap: Time from wipe start until it returns to the very bottom (sec), default 1.1
options.on: With ready, it starts the clock right on attach without waiting for images
options.look: if up, wipes from the bottom edge upward
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease · --fx-delay: Wipe duration (default 1s), curve, delay — for when each cell gets a different delay

from.where: index.html hero .cb-hero__list three (flower center .3s · mountain left .6s · leaf right 0s, phone 0·.3·.6s) — original .hero_slide_item.-wipe-out
